scope: Evaluation/cost research synthesis and reproducible proposal scenarios

criteria.finding: Seven primary evaluations and two pinned package source sets compared; favorable/adverse evidence, candidate coverage, remedies and open research explicit.
Bank offer target, clock and identification premises developed; exact randomized baseline, denominator failures, total-cost sensitivity and mechanism-level precision derived.
All published performance remains source-reported; own calculations are stipulated scenarios; no live model, bank truth, actual pricing or observed ROI claimed.

evidence.anchor: Connected evaluation, worked banking target, full cost, remedies and limits
Seven genuine PDFs and two pinned package source sets
Resolved and uninspected candidates with acquisition/search limits

No upstream package execution, hidden live evaluation or bank validation.
Main-reader integration and its exact release reviews remain separate work.
